# Summary

One paragraph explanation of the change.

# Motivation

What's the problem? Who feels it? What does life look like today?

# Detailed design

The actual proposal. Be specific. Include:

- Wire-format changes (if any)
- Manifest changes (if any)
- Migration path for existing agents
- Reference to existing tools / prior art

# Drawbacks

Why might this be a bad idea?

# Alternatives

What else did we consider? Why not those?

# Unresolved questions

What's still open? What do we punt to a follow-up RFC?

# Prior art

Links to comparable systems and what they got right or wrong.
